Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# This workflow will install Python dependencies, run tests and lint with a single version of Python
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/actions/language-and-framework-guides/using-python-with-github-actions

name: ShvatkaBotTest

on:
  workflow_call:

  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]
jobs:
  lint:
    # Skip the standalone PR run when the branch already triggers build.yml
    # (push) so lint/test/diagrams don't run twice. Still runs for forks and
    # for branches build.yml does not cover. Keep patterns in sync with build.yml.
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request'
      || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
      || !(startsWith(github.head_ref, 'claude/')
      || startsWith(github.head_ref, 'codex/')
      || startsWith(github.head_ref, 'feature/')
      || startsWith(github.head_ref, 'tech/')
      || startsWith(github.head_ref, 'fix/'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Set up Python 3.14
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.14'
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v8.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --group test
      - name: black (ruff format)
        run: source .venv/bin/activate && ruff format --check .
      - name: ruff
        run: source .venv/bin/activate && ruff check .
      - name: mypy
        run: source .venv/bin/activate && mypy .
  test:
    # See lint job: avoid running twice when build.yml already covers the branch.
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request'
      || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
      || !(startsWith(github.head_ref, 'claude/')
      || startsWith(github.head_ref, 'codex/')
      || startsWith(github.head_ref, 'feature/')
      || startsWith(github.head_ref, 'tech/')
      || startsWith(github.head_ref, 'fix/'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      checks: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Set up Python 3.14
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.14'
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v8.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --group test
      - name: Test with pytest
        run: >
          source .venv/bin/activate &&
          pytest
          --junitxml=junit.xml
          --cov-report "xml:coverage.xml"
          --cov=shvatka tests/
      - name: Publish test report
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v3
        with:
          name: pytest results
          path: junit.xml
          reporter: java-junit
      - name: Coverage summary
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: irongut/CodeCoverageSummary@v1.3.0
        with:
          filename: coverage.xml
          format: markdown
          output: both
      - name: Write coverage to job summary
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: cat code-coverage-results.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Coverage comment
        id: coverageComment
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: MishaKav/pytest-coverage-comment@main
        with:
          pytest-xml-coverage-path: ./c

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
